name: Encore

gist.Charme: Ability. Level one: uses one of YOUR heroes' Abilities as her own each turn. Level two: you hand her a card from your hand each turn. Level three: she takes control of one of your heroes for her turn.
gist.Love Shot: Any Charme hero can cast it: she draws from YOUR deck, then makes one of your heroes perform an attack or spell from her hand.
gist.Live Show: Looks at your hand and swaps cards with you as she pleases.
gist.Secret Entrance: Takes random cards from your hand.
gist.Mine! Mine! Mine!: Takes an equipped artifact off one of your heroes.
gist.Lilly, the Charming Infiltrator: Draws a card every time she takes a card from your deck or hand.
gist.Cute Starlet Megu: Her Singing can make her own creatures use their effects a second time.
gist.Gabby, the Boarding Broad: Draws a card whenever she takes a real hit; steals gold.
gist.Fans in High Positions: A hero with Charme at level three stands back up at full health when defeated.
gist.Golden Apple: Buys control of one of your heroes for a turn.
gist.Rosie, the School Idol: Free with enough Charme; lets its hero cast spells above its level.
gist.Lovely Teddy: Uses the effects of your creatures.
gist.Haressassin: A hard shot each turn, twice with Megu.
gist.Cannon Tower: Sturdy creature with a strong shot.
gist.Heavy Hit: Attack that stuns, sometimes performed by your own hero.

plan: Vivienne performs with your cards. Charme lets her borrow your Abilities at level one, take a card from your hand every turn at level two and take over one of your heroes for her whole turn at level three; Love Shot makes your own hero attack you, Mine! lifts your equipment, Live Show rearranges your hand, and Lilly draws on every theft. Her own contribution is a Haressassin that Megu fires twice. The better your hand and board, the better her deck; against a player with nothing worth taking it is thin. Her heroes are ordinary until Fans in High Positions is online.

looks.early: Charme stacked two high on Megu and Lilly, a Haressassin, a card of yours already in her hand.
looks.mid: Your White Eye on her hero, your own spells cast back at you, Lilly drawing with every theft.
looks.late: A Charme-three hero borrowing your Storm caster every turn and blowing kisses to the back row.

opening.tell: She is stacking Charme and has no board beyond one small creature.
opening.why: Her deck does little by itself in the first turns; everything you build (levels, equipment, a full hand) is what she will be using in the middle of the duel, so the patient plan arms her.

midgame.tell: Megu has Charme at level two and Vivienne holds a third copy.
midgame.why: Level three means she takes one of your heroes every turn; Fire Bomb removes a copy from the stack and keeps her at level two, which is the best use that potion will ever have here.

crisis.tell: One of her heroes has Charme three and borrows your Storm caster each turn; she has not shown Fans in High Positions yet.
crisis.why: The hero doing the borrowing must go down, and if Fans in High Positions brings it back at full health it must go down again; nothing you set up in the meantime stays yours.

endgame.tell: Your hand is nearly empty and so is hers; her own cards are a Haressassin and Heavy Hits.
endgame.why: With nothing left for her to take, her deck is a few plain attackers: answer the one shot that matters each turn and let the Storm finish.

opening.board: Ms. Laurent attaches Charme and borrows your Leadership for her own hand.

options.text: Burn Megu before the stack grows
Keep your hand small and poke

opening.board: Love Shot: she draws from your deck and your own Tarleinn casts her Heavy Hit at Nicolas.

options.text: Hit Lilly, who draws on every theft

opening.board: Live Show: she studies your hand and trades you two blanks for your Gathering Storm.

options.text: Empty your hand of anything worth taking
White Eye it back out of hers
Burn Megu while she is busy with your hand

Mine! Mine! Mine! takes The White Eye off your caster.

options.text: Fire Bomb it on her hero: it returns to your hand

midgame.board: Megu sings and the Haressassin fires twice.

crisis.board: Gabby reaches Charme three and takes your Storm caster for her turn.

options.text: Attach more for her to use

crisis.board: Gabby falls and Fans in High Positions stands her back up at full health.

options.text: Again; it only happens while she has the card

crisis.board: A Golden Apple takes a second hero of yours for the turn.

options.text: Cloud in a Bottle for what they do to you

options.text: Snow Cannon the Haressassin, tick Megu down
Look for something to take from her

endgame.board: Lilly alone, Charme one, borrowing your Alchemy each turn.
Golden Ankh on Megu for a last song.
